description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing documentation and help output of git commands. It defines functions to generate, compare, and verify the format and content of help messages and documentation files, and includes test cases to ensure consistency between different documentation sources.

methods.name: help_to_synopsis
methods.description: Generates a help synopsis for a git builtin command by executing 'git <builtin> -h' and processing the output.

methods.name: builtin_to_adoc
methods.description: Returns the path to the documentation file for a given builtin command.

methods.name: adoc_to_synopsis
methods.description: Converts a *.adoc documentation file into a synopsis format suitable for comparison.

methods.name: check_dashed_labels
methods.description: Checks a documentation file for labels that do not contain underscores or hyphens.

methods.name: align_after_nl
methods.description: Adjusts spacing in the output for alignment purposes based on the builtin name length.
